## External dependencies

- **No JS/CSS CDN libraries** in the pen panes (vanilla JS + CSS only).
- **Fonts** (CodePen editor / preview typically loads via “Stuff for \<head\>”; names referenced in CSS):
  - [DM Sans](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/DM+Sans)
  - [Playfair Display](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Playfair+Display)
  - [DM Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/DM+Mono)
- **Remote images** (author CDN): `https://rassweiler-it.de/images/codepen/...` (sandwich / bowl / lemonade / shack exterior).
- CodePen may optionally inject normalize.css in preview; not present as a link inside the HTML pane.

## Notable features in source

- Custom cursor follower (`#cur` + `#cur-ring`) + `cursor: none` on body
- Fixed nav + mobile hamburger drawer
- Full-viewport hero with parallax background image
- Wave SVG dividers + marquee strip
- “Today’s Special” featured section
- Filterable menu card grid (sandwich / bowl / side / drink)
- Scroll reveal (IntersectionObserver)
- Info / hours + footer
